name: Lake Thun & Lake Brienz
overview: Lake Thun and Lake Brienz are two pristine alpine lakes flanking Interlaken in the Bernese Oberland. These glacial lakes offer boat cruises with stunning mountain scenery, charming lakeside villages, and crystal-clear turquoise waters.
history: Both lakes were formed during the last ice age by glacial activity. Lake Thun connects to historic Thun town with its medieval castle, while Lake Brienz is famous for traditional woodcarving villages and the Giessbach Falls.
highlights: Turquoise glacial waters surrounded by Alps
Historic paddle steamers and modern boats
Giessbach Falls accessible by historic funicular
tips: Combined lake cruises available connecting both lakes via Interlaken. Best weather typically May-October. Swiss Travel Pass provides discounts. Spiez offers beautiful castle and vineyard views.
